mentions.name: Collider
mentions.description: A wrap-based package and dependency manager for Meson. It builds on Meson's wrap system: dependencies are declared in collider.json, collider lock produces reproducible installs with a lockfile, and projects can be pushed as wraps to a local or HTTP repository. It is compatible with WrapDB, so existing workflows continue to work while users get a way to publish and depend on their own packages with proper versioning. Licensed Apache-2.0.
mentions.problem: The author needed a way to use and push their own artifacts in Meson projects; WrapDB only covers upstream dependencies and lacked publishing own packages with proper versioning and a lockfile without hand-editing wrap files.
